description: Spray-focused CAN PGN catalog for PUFworks sniff/recorder/monitor.

entries.name: CCVS Wheel-Based Speed
entries.notes: SPN 84 bytes 1-2, 1/256 km/h. Primary speed for latency budget.

entries.name: Navigation / TCM attitude
entries.notes: ATX 0x1C: heading b0-1, speed b2-3, pitch b4-5, alt b6-7. Prefer FEF1 speed.

entries.name: ATX companion (roll)
entries.notes: ATX 0x1C bytes 2-3 /128 deg roll; pairs with FEE8.

entries.name: Vehicle Position (GNSS)
entries.notes: Lat/lon for geo-tagging; jd_atx lat offset -210.

entries.name: Vehicle Direction / Heading
entries.notes: Not seen on X119 implement tap; heading from FEE8.

entries.name: SOG/COG Rapid Update
entries.notes: Not seen on X119; may exist on VB1.

entries.name: Gyro / Yaw Rate (SSI2)
entries.notes: Not on X119; derive yaw from FEE8 heading delta.

entries.name: DM1 Active DTCs
entries.notes: Diagnostic context when spray faults (pressure, flow).

entries.name: TC Process Data / Section Control
entries.notes: DDI 141/157/158, section bitmap. Includes SR1 work msgs PF=0xCB.

entries.name: PGN 160 Process Data (DDI)
entries.notes: PF 0xA0. DDI 157 target rate, DDI 158 applied feedback.

entries.name: JD/GRC Proprietary Process Data
entries.notes: GRC rate/master/sections on Goldacres SA 0xCC; probe SRC/GWC on 616R.

entries.name: Request PGN
entries.notes: Address claim / DDOP requests — pairing context only.

entries.name: Engine Fluid Level / Pressure
entries.notes: Auxiliary fluid metrics on some platforms.

entries.name: Proprietary E700 family
entries.notes: Dominant from SA 0xBA; identify on Diagnostics Center.

entries.name: Proprietary A (BoomTrac candidate)
entries.notes: Capture all from BHC 0x8A until PGN confirmed.
